prompt: Origin (a photograph, graded, not generated): the same frame as hero-day, "Dried grass field under blue sky during daytime" by Chris Mongeau on Unsplash (Unsplash License, https://unsplash.com/photos/ZRdSZeVKBaE), given a dusk grade by script/site/make_hero.py. Every pixel is the photograph's, multiplied by a gain that changes with height: navy at the top of the sky, plum and ember toward the horizon, the land underexposed with its grass and trail kept and a warm rim at the crest. It is not a photograph taken at dusk.
